summary: Steady base flow of the cubic cavity at Re = 1920, above the critical Reynolds number, by Newton-GMRES.
description: 3D cubic cavity steady base flow at Re=1920 (above Re_c = 1916.63, so unstable), uniform lid, Newton-GMRES from the last DNS field at Re=1900. Regression values of this repository, not literature values.

newton_first_residual.note: Squared residual of the seed (the last field of 000_dns), column 7, first row. The tolerance of the run is 1e-10. A run that starts from a converged field fails this check.

newton_final_residual.note: Final Newton residual (column 7) must not exceed the Newton tolerance (column 8).

bf_vx_norm.note: Norm of vx of the converged base flow.

bf_vy_norm.note: Norm of vy of the converged base flow.

bf_vz_norm.note: Norm of vz of the converged base flow; vz is zero in a 2D flow, so this checks the 3D structure.
